extracted.intended_audience: clinical trial investigators, protocol authors, and peer reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for drafting and peer-reviewing clinical trial protocols to ensure minimum required content is reported. Focuses on the items a protocol should contain (SPIRIT 2025 checklist) rather than how to design or run the trial.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative information
rubrics_metrics.description: title, registration, protocol version, funding, roles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the protocol title and trial registry identifier(s); include protocol version/date; declare sources of funding and sponsors; describe roles and responsibilities (investigators, sponsor, committees).

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: background and rationale, objectives, trial design
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide scientific background and rationale for the trial, specify objectives or hypotheses, and describe the overall trial design (e.g., parallel, crossover, superiority/non-inferiority).

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods: Participants, interventions, outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: study setting, eligibility criteria, interventions, outcomes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe study setting(s) and locations, detailed eligibility/inclusion and exclusion criteria, precise description of interventions and comparators (how, when, by whom), and clearly defined primary and secondary outcomes with measurement timing and instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods: Assignment of interventions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State methods for sequence generation and allocation concealment, procedures for implementing allocation, and who is blinded (and how) during the trial; describe unblinding procedures if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods: Data collection, management, analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: data collection methods, data management, statistical methods
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify data collection procedures and instruments, plans for data entry and management, quality assurance, and statistical analysis methods (including any pre-specified subgroup or sensitivity analyses and handling of missing data).

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods: Monitoring
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe data monitoring arrangements (e.g., data monitoring committee), procedures for detecting and reporting harms/adverse events, and plans for auditing trial conduct; SPIRIT 2025 places additional emphasis on harms assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethics and dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: research ethics approval, protocol amendments, consent, confidentiality, declaration of interests, access to data, ancillary care, dissemination policy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include approvals from ethics committees, processes for communicating protocol amendments, informed consent processes, measures to protect confidentiality, declarations of interests, plans for access to data and ancillary care, and policies for dissemination of results; SPIRIT 2025 adds an open science emphasis relevant to data/access/dissemination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide sample informed consent documents and materials as appendices; describe collection, storage, and use of biological specimens when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report plans for sharing data, statistical code, and other materials to promote transparency and reproducibility; include statements on data availability and access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harms assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: additional emphasis on harms assessment (SPIRIT 2025 update)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide detailed plans for monitoring, capturing, grading, and reporting adverse events and harms, and how harms data will be analyzed and disseminated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of interventions and comparators
rubrics_metrics.description: updated emphasis on describing interventions and comparators
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give sufficient detail on interventions and comparators (components, dosing, timing, delivery, adherence strategies) to allow replication and assessment of fidelity and applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient and public involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: new item on patient and public involvement in trial design, conduct and reporting (SPIRIT 2025 update)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document whether and how patients/public were involved in developing the protocol, selecting outcomes, or in dissemination plans, and describe their roles and contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule diagram (flow/timeline)
rubrics_metrics.description: diagram illustrating the schedule of enrollment, interventions and assessments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a diagram or table that clearly shows timing of enrollment, interventions, and outcome assessments across study visits to aid comprehension of trial procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensiveness of planned activities
rubrics_metrics.description: checklist recommends a full description of what is planned; it does not prescribe how to design or conduct a trial
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the protocol contains a complete, transparent description of planned methods and procedures (so reviewers can assess risk of bias, feasibility, and ethics) rather than guidance about trial design choices.
